ownerDecision.scope: Separate M6 with a new turret and Bradley chassis carrying extensive layered armor, cages and equipment. Owner subsequently requested a new M3A3 turret base as well. Owner requested a substantially wider, heavily equipped M2A3-style turret so the quad launcher no longer dominates; current structural width is 2.68 m (previous 2.20 m).

m6_linebacker.silhouette: Original upgraded M6 on the native Bradley chassis. Broad 2.68 m welded turret, full sloping cheek masses around a true elevation bay, layered flank cassettes, large shoulder cabinets, shielded hatch, panoramic and gunner optics, paired lamps, peripheral cameras, M2 remote station, filled full-width bustle rack and shoulder cages. Compact left quad Stinger pod is 30 percent smaller in each dimension and sits on a close-fitting articulating cradle. Clipped layered hull skirts and rear slat cages. Historical M6 establishes the weapon layout only.
